region_scene_page.standard: Psychedelic pop is not only long jams and acid-rock heaviness. The Beatles, Beach Boys, Turtles, Monkees, Jefferson Airplane, and others brought dream logic into singles: odd timbres, tape edits, surreal images, bright harmonies, and arrangements that seem to open hidden rooms. Compared with heavy psych, this lane keeps melodic accessibility. Compared with baroque pop, it is more hallucinatory and rhythmically open.
